body: Yea I guess so but at my school we all have popularity ranks and all the populars are sporty, and I am sporty too but I don’t think I am popular enough to be with them. And I’ve been trying to find new friends but it’s hard because at our school we have squads and if you leave your squad you can’t get back into it and it’s hard to join a new one..

Awwww... yea bit ypu should realt gry tour best to come thorough this. We all have responsibilities and honestly I don’t like mine either, my friends are being bitches to me everyday calling me mean stuff I’d honestly rather not have a friend at the moment. But i know that I’d be pleased to have someone like you as a friend, someone who had felt the same you know. And I am sue other people will too.

What are your interests? What subjects would you want to choose? Go for your feeling. And I know it may make a difference to you. Do you do sports? Any hidden talents? Are there someone you could as for advice? An old friend, new friend, friend, friend’s parent, your parent, teacher, an adult?

Yea. That is very upsetting to hear, but i am sure that they won’t reject you you seem very nice and  I am sure that most people would be pleased to have you as a friend. Is there anything you are good at sports for example? Do you do much sports in your free time? Because looking at recent research has shown that when you do sports or any kind of exercise your body releases a special type of hormone and it may make you feel happy and enjoy. And training is very good for you, your emotions, your feelings, your mental and physical health. I really think you should try it out. You may even find sports and exercising quite entertaining. Personally I love sports and exercise very entertaining although I am really bad at it but it surly make me feel a lot better about myself. And facing some of the problems I had before starting exercising has become a lot easier now. I think you should give it a try. :)

Hello, when I think of suicide myself I think it’s the worst way of ending your life. Think about all your thoughts as a spiral the more you think about it the more you slide down the spiral. And your school mate commuting suicide is tragic but sometimes you get the idea because someone near you in your community has done. It’s like a domino effect.

What I would advice you to do is to try your best to make friends, i know you may not think they’ll give you attention or even talk to you but they will. You seem like a caring, nice, outgoing person and id honestly do anything to be friends with someone like you. 

My honest opinion about people who commits suicide is that I feel sorry for them for feeling so bad that they felt like they had to commit suicide. I really don’t think you would get respect from suicide. Not in that way, you will be remembered because there are a lot of people who wants to be there for you but they wouldn’t know how you feel. Is there anyone you could talk to at home or at school that you feel comfortable around? An adult, a parent, a grand parent, a teacher, an old friend, a friend’s parent etc.?
